serverActions.note: createAccountFromVerifiedEmail: service-role createUser({email_confirm:true}) from a client-callable Server Action with a caller-supplied email; no server-side proof of the verification token. Anyone can create a pre-confirmed account for any e-mail (squatting / impersonation).

verifyToken: public; no rate limit; returns email, full_name and result_json to any holder of a valid token (token is the secret, so acceptable) — but brute-force is unthrottled. Also marks verified_at on every call.
markTokenUsed: public state change keyed only by the token; not bound to an e-mail; no result check. Low impact (token = secret) — hardening only.

findings.title: /admin/users/[userId]/view leaked a target user's e-mail and admin data to any signed-in non-admin
findings.evidence: Persona B and C fetched each other's data (service-role queries streamed into the 307 body). Fixed: requireAdmin() in the page; re-verified. UNCOMMITTED and NOT DEPLOYED.

findings.title: Brand fonts (Cormorant Garamond / DM Sans) do not resolve — text renders in a fallback face sitewide
findings.evidence: layout.tsx uses next/font (CSS vars) but ~99 files and globals.css:38 use the literal family names; no @font-face exists. Only machines with the fonts installed look right. See A-007..A-009. [Already scored via the automated findings/verdicts; component=none avoids double counting.]

findings.title: /api/franchise/brand-view: anonymous insert, no rate limit; malformed JSON returned 500
findings.evidence: anon POST -> 500. Malformed-JSON + unread insert error FIXED in source (uncommitted; not re-verified at runtime — scratch build predates it). Rate limit still absent. [Already scored via the automated findings/verdicts; component=none avoids double counting.]

findings.title: State-changing or costly work behind GET routes
findings.evidence: download routes, GET /api/documents/[documentId], /api/case-profile/build, /api/franchise/matches, /api/renewal/intake, /api/market-analysis and the paid-LLM GET /api/simulator/interview-prep — prefetch/crawlers/CSRF-by-link can trigger writes or LLM spend.

findings.title: Public Server Action creates pre-confirmed accounts for any e-mail (SA1)
findings.evidence: createAccountFromVerifiedEmail uses the service role with email_confirm:true and no server-side proof the caller owns the e-mail or holds a valid token. Fix before launch. [Already scored via the automated findings/verdicts; component=none avoids double counting.]

findings.title: /api/email/results trusts the e-mail in the request body
findings.evidence: Anyone can trigger a results e-mail to any address (3/60 min limit only); req.json() outside try (S4). [Already scored via the automated findings/verdicts; component=none avoids double counting.]

findings.title: Middleware auth guard is dead for /franchise/* and /renewal/*
findings.evidence: AUTH_ROUTES lists them, but isExistingGatedPath() (middleware.ts:247) returns early for those paths, so anon gets HTTP 200 shells of /renewal/intake, /renewal/documents, /franchise/discover, /franchise/matches, /franchise/connect (curl-verified). Data APIs enforce auth themselves; the pages rely on client redirects.

findings.title: /modules and /score are prerendered redirects with no Location header
findings.evidence: HTTP 307 with an empty Location for anon /modules and B /score; browsers land nowhere useful. [Already scored via the automated findings/verdicts; component=none avoids double counting.]

findings.title: GET /api/simulator/case-gaps always returns 500
findings.evidence: persona B with a valid applicationId -> 500 (A-006). [Already scored via the automated findings/verdicts; component=none avoids double counting.]
